title: The five kinds of cards
goal: Recognize Leaders, Characters, Events, Stages and DON!! at a glance.

callouts.label: Power: how strong it is in a fight (5000).
Life: you start the game with this many Life cards (4).
Color: your deck may only use these colors (green and red).
Effect: a special ability. Leaders have one that works all game.

steps.html: This is a Leader. You have exactly one, and it stays on the table all game. Tap the numbered pins.

callouts.label: Cost: rest this many DON!! to play it (5).
Counter: trash it from your hand while defending to add +1000 power.
Effect: Jinbe has [Blocker]. Tap it to see what that means.
Type: the groups he belongs to (Fish-Man and Straw Hat Crew).

steps.html: This is a Character, the most common kind of card. Characters are your crew: they attack, block and protect.

callouts.label: [Counter]: you can use it while your opponent attacks you.
[Trigger]: a free effect if this card is flipped from your Life.

steps.html: This is an Event. You pay its cost, do what it says once, then it goes to your Trash.

callouts.label: Effect: works again and again while the Stage stays on the table.

steps.html: This is a Stage, a place that gives you a lasting bonus. You can only have 1 Stage at a time. Stages can't attack and can't be attacked.

And then there's DON!!. DON!! cards aren't in your deck. You get new ones every turn and use them to pay costs or to power up your cards.

Quick sort:

  • Leader: you, the captain. 1 per deck.
  • Character: crew that stays and fights.
  • Event: a one-time move.
  • Stage: a place with a lasting bonus.
  • DON!!: energy.

quiz.q: Which card type goes to the trash right after you use it?
quiz.why: Events are one-time effects. Pay, resolve, trash.

quiz.q: Where do you find how many DON!! a Character costs?
quiz.why: The cost is the big number in the top-left corner.

quiz.q: What does the number in a Leader's Life spot tell you?
choices: How many Life cards you start with
How many times it can attack
How many Characters you can have
quiz.why: You start the game with that many face-down Life cards.
